# `assets/EngineModel.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/EngineModel.js`

engine/assets/EngineModel.js — the unified runtime object.  Core rule of the ingestion runtime: a model file is raw evidence, not the runtime object. The importer parses a source file into an EngineModel, which keeps every layer explicitly separate (source ≠ visual mesh ≠ material ≠ collider ≠ SDF ≠ skeleton ≠ animation ≠ runtime rig ≠ render surface). Layers that have not been built yet are explicitly null/empty — never faked — so the editor can show exactly what was detected vs generated.  Corrections (axis/scale/origin, material fixes, rig edits) live in metadata as an ImportTransform / import profile and are NEVER baked destructively into the source: the original imported look must always be recoverable.

## Functions

### `createEngineModel(init = {})`

Create an empty EngineModel with every layer present but unbuilt.

**Parameters:**

- `[init]` *(object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._

**Returns:** engine model (mutable; the import pipeline fills it in)

### `createImportTransform(init = {})`

A non-destructive correction applied at runtime (never baked into source). Confidence drives the auto-apply / review / preview / neutral policy.

### `createEngineNode(init = {})`

A node in the preserved source hierarchy (transforms kept as-authored).

### `createEngineMesh(init = {})`

A mesh = a set of primitives (submeshes), each with its own material.

### `createEnginePrimitive(init = {})`

A primitive/submesh: geometry + a single material binding.

### `layerStatus(model)`

Report which layers are built (non-empty) vs explicitly unbuilt.

## Constants

- `ENGINE_MODEL_LAYERS` — Canonical layer list — used by the editor to show built vs unbuilt layers.
